Research · 2025

Published IoT research

SOCIO explored how connected technology could support participation, safety and sustainable urban living in a smart community app.

The publication

“Design and Implementation of SOCIO: A Smart Community App for Participation, Safety, and Sustainable Urban Living” was presented at the 10th International Conference on Internet of Things: Connected Technologies (ICIoTCT 2025).

My contribution

I co-designed IoT modules for safety monitoring and sustainable urban living. The work brought connected-device thinking into a broader community application rather than treating each feature as an isolated device.

Research focus

The project considered how participation, safety and sustainability can live within one app experience.
